items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: So he sent me to Vanderbilt. I had an interview with the head of the floor managers... [INTERVIEWER] What was Vanderbilt? [INTERVIEWEE] Grand Central Station, Vanderbilt Avenue.
